description: Make a pixel-art monster sprite sheet from named parts drawn by code: pick a body (slime, bat, ghost, golem, dragonling and more), eyes, mouth, horns, wings, tail, arms, pattern and colours that fit what the user described, and the GameShipKit Pixel Monster Maker draws idle, move, attack, hurt and die frames in 4 directions or side view. mood fills the parts you leave out (cute, scary or boss). Returns the PNG sheet, the column layout and a link to the editor.

animations.description: Animations in the sheet, left to right. Frames: idle 2, move 4, attack 3, hurt 2, die 3. Default: idle, move.

glow.description: Eyes and aura glow colour, hex.

second.description: Belly, horns and pattern colour, hex.

directions.description: 4dir: rows front, right, left, back (top-down RPG). side: one row facing right (platformer).

mood.description: Fill the parts and colours you did not set with ones that fit this mood.

parts.description: Parts by name. Leave a part out for its default, or set mood or seed to fill it at random.

body.description: Slime, Bat, Ghost, Eyeball, Mushroom, Spider, Golem, Plant, Skull, Dragonling, Wisp, Beast, Boar, Snake, Beetle, Bird, Fish, Crab, Mimic, Crystal, Cloud, Treant, Octopus, Imp, Cactus

element.description: None, Fire, Ice, Poison, Lightning, Shadow

eyes.description: Round, Cute, Angry, Glowing, Cyclops, Three eyes, Sleepy, Many eyes, Cross

mouth.description: None, Smile, Fangs, Big bite, Zigzag, Tiny, Tongue

pattern.description: None, Spots, Stripes, Belly, Dark bottom, Scales

tail.description: None, Thin tail, Devil tail, Fluffy tail, Lizard tail, Spiked club

top.description: None, Small horns, Big horns, Cat ears, Antennae, Single horn, Spikes, Crown, Halo, Sprout, Bow

wings.description: None, Bat wings, Feather wings, Back spikes, Fins, Dragon wings, Aura

scale.description: Pixels per art pixel in the PNG. Keep 1 for a game; 4x and 8x are in the editor with Pro.

seed.description: Fill every part and colour you did not set at random, the same way for the same seed. Leave out to use plain defaults instead.

size.description: Frame size in pixels. This server draws up to 32 px; the local server (npx -y gameshipkit-mcp) and the editor link do every size.

name: pixel_monster
title: Pixel monster sprite sheet
